elements.text: Enable verbose logging and see if anything useful shows up.  Something is odd if the node is running and not doing anything (as opposed to just taking a while to process).  For an initial sync, I recommend using the
peer = localhost:8333

option if possible where you're running a sync'd bitcoind, so that you don't have to rely on random peers.  Also, as you do sync higher and higher, making snapshots of progress may help in case of an unclean shutdown at some point in the future.
